title.es: Centro comercial medieval del barrio rico
title.pt: Centro comercial medieval do bairro nobre

generated.description: A large multi-story medieval shopping center built mostly from oak logs, oak planks, nether brick and stone brick, with orange and cyan wool accents and glass windows. It spans about 68 wide, 42 high and 27 deep, and the interior holds chests, furnaces, bookshelves, an enchanting table, an ender chest and signs for stocking shops.
